thread.title: Leadership Trust

title: Leadership Trust
text:
NFIB’s Leadership Trust recognizes and engages top donors to our political action committees, our NFIB PACs. NFIB PACs are the foundation of NFIB’s federal and state political programs. Contributions to NFIB PACs directly support NFIB-endorsed candidates running for federal and state office, promoting educational programs such as the Get Out the Vote initiatives, and provide resources for strategic political communications during election cycles. Please join NFIB’s Leadership Trust today and help spread our influence as the voice of small business.
Your Contribution Helps Us Fight For Small Business
- NFIB Support Pro Small business candidates running for federal office
- Drive grassroots advocacy connecting businesses of every size
- Product voter education materials promoting legislators who understand small business issues
- Develop and distribute media campaigns spreading our message via broadcast, online, and social networking channels
Four NFIB Leadership Trust Contribution Levels
Contribute
**Contributions to the National Federation of Independent Business (NFIB) Political Programs are voluntary contributions to be used for the administrative and communication costs of the state and federal political programs where permitted. Paid for and authorized by the National Federation of Independent Business (NFIB). Dawn Simpson, NFIB Treasurer, 555 12th St. NW, Suite 1001, Washington, D.C. 20004. NFIB.com
